text:
Attention, Gym Challengers who have made it
through the Gym Challenge.
The Semifinals will be starting soon!\c
Please head to the stadium pitch when you
are ready.

This is it. I really made it.\c
I made it through the Gym Challenge. There
might be four remainin’ in the Semifinals...\c
But I’m the one who’s gonna win through
and battle the Champion.[VAR 0114(000D)]
I’ve gotta rest to be in top condition\nfor tomorrow...\r\nYou get some rest, too. G’night...[VAR 0114(000D)]
